# NPM Improved v1.7.2

## Proxy host editor usability

- Restore vertical scrolling in the Add/Edit Proxy Host dialog on desktop, including after a failed save displays an error message.
- Keep the modal header and Save/Cancel footer accessible while scrolling long proxy host configurations.
- Confine tab-strip horizontal scrolling to the navigation area instead of the entire editor.
- Bound the dialog to the available viewport height on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
- Preserve the existing NPMi user interface, proxy configuration, certificates, and NPMX networking behavior.

## Updating

Use the built-in NPM Improved updater to install v1.7.2 after the release assets are published. Existing proxy hosts, certificates, and local data are retained.
